edges.label: Claimed 1993 UFO briefing of sitting CIA Director Woolsey (disputed)
edges.note: CSETI founder Steven Greer says he briefed sitting CIA Director R. James Woolsey on UFOs on 13 December 1993 at a dinner in Arlington arranged by John Petersen, and quotes a Petersen memo referring to sabotage of 'Project Starlight', the CSETI disclosure effort. Woolsey and the other attendees disputed this characterisation in a signed 16 September 1999 letter, saying it was a dinner party and that Greer's published account was distorted. Both accounts are on the record; the relationship is contested.
